solver_sql: WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.loser_id, p.hand, AVG(m.winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht, AVG(m.loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rank FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.loser_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht_by_hand, AVG(avg_loser_rank) as avg_loser_rank_by_hand FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_loser_rank_by_hand) as overall_avg FROM step2) SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_winner_ht_by_hand, step2.avg_loser_rank_by_hand, step2.avg_loser_rank_by_hand - step3.overall_avg as diff FROM step2, step3

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id as col1, AVG(winner_age) as col2 FROM matches WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(col2) as col1 FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.col1, s1.col2, s1.col2 - s2.col1 as col3 FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s1.col2 > s2.col1), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(col2) as col1 FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.col1, s3.col2, s3.col3, s3.col2 / s4.col1 as col4 FROM step3 s3, step4 s4) SELECT * FROM step5 ORDER BY col4 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT AVG(avg_draw) as avg_draw_result, AVG(avg_rank_diff) as avg_rank_diff_result, AVG(draw_diff) as avg_draw_diff_result FROM (SELECT p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw, AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) as avg_rank_diff, AVG(m.draw_size) - (SELECT AVG(draw_val) FROM (SELECT AVG(m2.draw_size) as draw_val FROM matches m2 JOIN players p2 ON m2.loser_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY p2.hand)) as draw_diff FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.loser_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.hand HAVING AVG(m.draw_size) > (SELECT AVG(draw_val) FROM (SELECT AVG(m2.draw_size) as draw_val FROM matches m2 JOIN players p2 ON m2.loser_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY p2.hand)))

SELECT AVG(avg_loser_age) as avg_age_result, AVG(avg_rank_diff) as avg_rank_diff_result, AVG(age_diff) as avg_age_diff_result FROM (SELECT p.hand, AVG(m.loser_age) as avg_loser_age, AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) as avg_rank_diff, AVG(m.loser_age) - (SELECT AVG(age_val) FROM (SELECT AVG(m2.loser_age) as age_val FROM matches m2 JOIN players p2 ON m2.loser_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY p2.hand)) as age_diff FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.loser_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.hand HAVING AVG(m.loser_age) > (SELECT AVG(age_val) FROM (SELECT AVG(m2.loser_age) as age_val FROM matches m2 JOIN players p2 ON m2.loser_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY p2.hand)))

SELECT 
    step3.surface,
    step3.avg_lrp,
    step3.diff,
    step3.avg_lrp / step4.avg_diff
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s1.surface,
        s1.avg_lrp,
        s1.avg_lrp - (
            SELECT AVG(avg_lrp) FROM (
                SELECT surface, AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_lrp 
                FROM matches WHERE surface IS NOT NULL GROUP BY surface
            )
        ) as diff
    FROM (
        SELECT surface, AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_lrp 
        FROM matches WHERE surface IS NOT NULL GROUP BY surface
    ) s1
    WHERE s1.avg_lrp > (
        SELECT AVG(avg_lrp) FROM (
            SELECT surface, AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_lrp 
            FROM matches WHERE surface IS NOT NULL GROUP BY surface
        )
    )
) step3
CROSS JOIN (

        SELECT 
            s1b.surface,

                SELECT AVG(avg_lrp) FROM (

                )
            ) as diff
        FROM (

            SELECT AVG(avg_lrp) FROM (
                SELECT surface, AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_lrp 
                FROM matches WHERE surface IS NOT NULL GROUP BY surface
            )
        )
    )
) step4
WHERE step3.avg_lrp > step4.avg_diff

SELECT 
    step4.hand,
    step4.avg_age,
    step4.diff,
    step4.diff / step5.avg_diff
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s2.hand,

    FROM (

    ) s2
    CROSS JOIN (

            FROM (

CROSS JOIN (

        ) s2b
        CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT AVG(avg_age) as overall_avg FROM (
                SELECT hand, AVG(avg_age) as avg_age

                    FROM matches JOIN players ON players.player_id = matches.loser_id

SELECT

FROM (

            CROSS JOIN (

    ) step4

) step5

SELECT

FROM (

SELECT 
    SUM(step5.cnt) as col1,
    AVG(step5.proportion) as col2,
    AVG(step5.diff) as col3
FROM (
    SELECT 
        step3.player_id,
        step3.cnt,
        step3.proportion,
        step3.cnt - step4.avg_proportion as diff
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            s1.player_id,
            s1.cnt,
            CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total_sum as proportion
        FROM (
            SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id
        ) s1
        CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_sum FROM (
                SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id
            )
        ) s2
    ) step3
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM (
            SELECT 
                CAST(s1b.cnt AS REAL) / s2b.total_sum as proportion
            FROM (
                SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id
            ) s1b
            CROSS JOIN (
                SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_sum FROM (
                    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id

            ) s2b

    WHERE step3.cnt > step4.avg_proportion
) step5

SELECT 
    step4.hand,

FROM (

    ) s2
    CROSS JOIN (

            SELECT hand, AVG(avg_wh) as avg_wh

                SELECT loser_id, hand, AVG(winner_ht) as avg_wh

        FROM (

        CROSS JOIN (

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(CAST(m.winner_rank_points AS FLOAT)) as avg_points FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_points) as avg_per_hand FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.hand, s1.avg_points, s1.avg_points - s2.avg_per_hand as diff FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.hand = s2.hand WHERE s1.avg_points > s2.avg_per_hand), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.hand, s3.avg_points, s3.diff, s3.avg_points - s4.overall as diff2 FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s3.avg_points > s4.overall) SELECT s5.hand, AVG(s5.avg_points), AVG(s5.diff), AVG(s5.diff2) FROM step5 s5 GROUP BY s5.hand

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(CAST(m.loser_rank_points AS FLOAT)) as avg_loser_points FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_loser_points) as overall FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.hand, s1.avg_loser_points, s1.avg_loser_points - s2.overall as diff FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_loser_points > s2.overall), step4 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_loser_points) as avg_by_hand FROM step3 GROUP BY hand), step5 AS (SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.hand, s3.avg_loser_points, s3.diff, s3.avg_loser_points - s4.avg_by_hand as diff2 FROM step3 s3 JOIN step4 s4 ON s3.hand = s4.hand WHERE s3.avg_loser_points > s4.avg_by_hand) SELECT s5.hand, AVG(s5.avg_loser_points), AVG(s5.diff), AVG(s5.diff2) FROM step5 s5 GROUP BY s5.hand

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_ht) as col3 FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE m.loser_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(col3) as col2 FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(col2) as col1 FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.hand, step2.col2, step2.col2 - step3.col1 as col3 FROM step2, step3 WHERE step2.col2 > step3.col1), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(col3) as col1 FROM step4) SELECT step4.hand, step4.col2, step4.col3, step4.col2 - step5.col1 as col4 FROM step4, step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, AVG(winner_age) as avg_winner_age FROM matches WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_winner_age) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.loser_id, s1.avg_winner_age, (s1.avg_winner_age - s2.overall_avg) as diff FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_winner_age > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.loser_id, s3.avg_winner_age, s3.diff, (s3.avg_winner_age - s4.avg_diff) as diff2 FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_diff IS NOT NULL AND s3.diff > s4.avg_diff) SELECT AVG(avg_winner_age), AVG(diff), AVG(diff2) FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE m.draw_size IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_draw) as avg_by_hand FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_by_hand) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.hand, s2.avg_by_hand, (s2.avg_by_hand - s3.overall_avg) as diff FROM step2 s2, step3 s3 WHERE s3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s2.avg_by_hand > s3.overall_avg), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step4) SELECT s4.hand, s4.avg_by_hand, s4.diff, s4.avg_by_hand / s5.avg_diff FROM step4 s4, step5 s5 WHERE s5.avg_diff IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.player_id, s1.cnt, (s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt) as diff FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.player_id, s3.cnt, s3.diff, (s3.cnt - s4.avg_diff) as diff2 FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_diff IS NOT NULL AND s3.diff > s4.avg_diff) SELECT AVG(s5.cnt), AVG(s5.diff), AVG(s5.diff2) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    m.winner_id,
    p.hand,
    AVG(m.winner_age) as col3,
    AVG((m.winner_rank_points - m.loser_rank_points) / m.loser_rank_points) as col4
  FROM matches m
  JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id
  GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    hand as col1,
    AVG(col3) as col2,
    AVG(col4) as col3
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY hand
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT AVG(col2) as col1
  FROM step2
)
SELECT 
  step2.col1,
  step2.col2,
  step2.col3,
  step2.col2 - step3.col1 as col4
FROM step2, step3
WHERE step2.col2 > step3.col1 AND step3.col1 IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.hand,
    AVG(m.winner_age) as col2,
    AVG((m.winner_rank_points - m.loser_rank_points) / m.loser_rank_points) as col3
  FROM matches m
  JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id
  GROUP BY p.hand
),
step2 AS (

  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.hand,
    step1.col2,
    step1.col3,
    step1.col2 - step2.col1 as col4
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step1.col2 > step2.col1
)
SELECT 
  AVG(col2) as col1,
  AVG(col3) as col2,
  AVG(col4) as col3
FROM step3

SELECT step3.loser_id, step3.avg_rank_diff, step3.diff_from_overall FROM (SELECT step1.loser_id, step1.avg_rank_diff, step1.avg_rank_diff - step2.overall_avg as diff_from_overall FROM (SELECT m.loser_id, AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) as avg_rank_diff FROM matches m WHERE m.loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.loser_id) step1, (SELECT AVG(avg_rank_diff) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) as avg_rank_diff FROM matches m WHERE m.loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.loser_id)) step2 WHERE step1.avg_rank_diff > step2.overall_avg) step3 ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_ht) as avg_loser_ht FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE m.loser_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_loser_ht) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.winner_id, p.hand, step1.avg_loser_ht, step1.avg_loser_ht - step2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_loser_ht > step2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3 GROUP BY hand) SELECT step3.winner_id, step3.hand, step3.avg_loser_ht, step3.diff, step3.diff - step4.avg_diff as final_diff FROM step3 JOIN step4 ON step3.hand = step4.hand WHERE step3.diff > step4.avg_diff ORDER BY final_diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rank, AVG(CAST(m.winner_ht AS REAL) / m.loser_ht) as height_ratio FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE m.loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_ht IS NOT NULL AND m.loser_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_loser_rank) as avg_rank, AVG(height_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_rank, step2.avg_ratio, step2.avg_ratio - step3.overall_avg as diff FROM step2, step3 WHERE step2.avg_ratio > step3.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(hand) as avg_hand, AVG(avg_rank) as avg_rank, AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step4

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.loser_id, p.hand, AVG(m.winner_age) as avg_winner_age, AVG(CAST(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) / m.winner_rank_points) as rank_ratio FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.loser_id = p.player_id WHERE m.winner_age IS NOT NULL AND m.loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points != 0 GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_winner_age) as avg_age, AVG(rank_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_age) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_age, step2.avg_ratio, step2.avg_age - step3.overall_avg as diff FROM step2, step3 WHERE step2.avg_age > step3.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_age) as avg_age_result, AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio_result, AVG(diff) as avg_diff_result FROM step4

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_age / m.winner_age) as ratio FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_ratio, step2.avg_ratio - step3.overall_avg as diff FROM step2 CROSS JOIN step3 WHERE step2.avg_ratio > step3.overall_avg), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avgs FROM step4), step6 AS (SELECT step4.hand, step4.avg_ratio, step4.diff, step4.avg_ratio / step5.avg_of_avgs as ratio_div FROM step4 CROSS JOIN step5) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(diff), AVG(ratio_div) FROM step6
